Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

### ① Derived judgments

- (a) Letter and the two ⛔ hold. `anchorsNumericAxis` / `axisHasScale` in `packages/plugin-charts/src/AdvancedChartImpl.tsx` ask whether ANY row gives the axis a scale; there is no "reject booleans" predicate (`isPlottableCoord` still accepts a boolean, and the head comment now points at the whole-dataset refusal) and no authoring-time type check (`packages/types` and `packages/i18n` untouched; one commit, four files). The mixed control cannot fire it: measured at head, scatter `[10, true, false]` draws 3 marks with no `[data-chart-error]` and no note; bar / line / area / combo with a boolean beside a number draw. The `:226` pin in `AdvancedChartImpl.degeneratePosition.test.tsx` is rewritten, not deleted: the mixed half keeps its 3-marks / no-note / no-`no-plottable-points` assertions and adds no-`no-numeric-value`; the all-boolean half asserts 0 marks, no plot, and the refusal text. Both touched test files run green at head (136 tests), the whole package runs `68 files / 698 tests` green, matching the PR body.
- (b) Predicate versus what draws: the `makeNumber` mirror is exact for scalars. Read from `recharts@3.10.1` `es6/state/selectors/axisSelectors.js`: `makeNumber` accepts `isNumOrStr(val) || val instanceof Date` with a well-behaved `Number(val)`, which is byte-for-byte what `anchorsNumericAxis` does for non-booleans. Measured at head under the package's 480x320 harness against the dev's base `cd7b728b9` (same probe, both trees): scatter `''` on x draws 2 marks on both trees (so `Number('') = 0` really does place a point); `' 12 '` / `'0x10'` draw 2 on both; `'Infinity'` and `Infinity` on x are caught earlier by `no-plottable-points` on both; `'1,234'` likewise. Series families: line `''` draws 1 path on both; bar `''` draws 0 rectangles on both and stays silent on head (the dev states this); bar `[null, '3']` draws 1 on both; bar `[null, 'n/a']` drew 0 silently on base and now refuses with a true sentence. Stack carve-out: bar stacked all-boolean draws 1 on both; area stacked all-`false` draws 1 on both; line stacked all-boolean draws 0 on both and stays silent on head. The line claim is verified in source: neither `<Line>` (combo arm, shared tail) spreads `stackProps`, so treating a line's `stack` as stacked errs to silence, never to a refusal over marks. Every refusal sentence over a scalar-valued shape that reaches it is literally true.
- (b, falsified) The mirror stops one function short of Recharts' reader. Immediately below `makeNumber`, `makeDomain` also accepts a two-element array `[lo, hi]` (range bars / range areas), and `getValueByDataKey` resolves a dotted `dataKey` through `get(obj, 'a.b')`. Measured, base versus head: bar rows `v: [1,3]` / `[2,5]` drew 2 rectangles on base and now render `no-numeric-value` reading "none of the 2 rows has a numeric value for v", which is false about the picture; area `[1,3]` drew 1 path on base and now refuses. Bar / line with series `[{dataKey:'a.b'},{dataKey:'w'}]` over rows `{a:{b:3}, w:true}` drew 3 / 2 marks on base and now refuse (nested key never anchors, the boolean sibling satisfies the `carried` gate). `ChartSchema.data` is `Array<Record<string, any>>` (the accept surface admits both shapes), and inline `data` is exactly the path the census named as where this defect flows. No producer in this repo emits either shape (grep over plugin-charts, plugin-dashboard, plugin-report, app-shell, plugin-view, docs and examples finds no dotted `dataKey` and no range arrays; `buildChartSeries` in `packages/core/src/utils/chart-series.ts` aggregates to numbers), so no product-composed tile regresses, but a hand-authored tile that draws today would now refuse with a false sentence, which is the exact failure the ruling's first ⛔ names.
- (c) Scope narrowing is faithful. The ruling's scope sentence is "the silent cases the 2026-09-08 census measured (5590877640): x all-boolean, y all-boolean, both, and the line / bar / area families where the same predicate holds"; that census measured booleans only, and the absent-key shape has its own record (objectui#8266 / objectui#8269) whose render pins state in their headers that a future guard "must be re-decided rather than a silent behaviour change nobody notices". The dev's `carried` gate keeps those two out-of-surface pins green (verified in the 698-test run), covers every census case, disclosed the narrowing in the PR body and as an open question with options. Verdict on this point: not an under-delivery; the PR need not widen. The absent-key shape belongs to a separate seat decision, as the pins themselves ask.
- (d) Precedence and channel are correct. Outer wrapper: `noNumericSeriesValue` is computed only when `missingCategoryKey` and `noPlottableSeries` are both null and is returned after both; measured at head, rows without the category key still yield `missing-category-key`, `series: []` still yields `no-plottable-series`. Scatter arm: `SeriesArityRefusal` (`series.length > 1`) first, then `PositionRefusal` (`plottable === 0`), then the new check, then the `unplotted-points` footnote; measured, `[true, 'n/a']` on x drew 0 marks under a footnote claiming 1 of 2 not drawn on base and now refuses. The code `no-numeric-value` is distinct from `no-plottable-series` (which stays `'empty' | 'undeclared'` on `series` alone) and from `no-plottable-points`. Channel is `ChartRefusal` with `role="status"` and `data-chart-error`. The sentence is JSX literal text, no i18n key; magnitude families (pie / donut / funnel / treemap / radar) never receive it.
- (e) Callers: `ChartRenderer.tsx` is the only importer of `AdvancedChartImpl`; producers are `DashboardRenderer` / `widgetDispatch` / `DatasetWidget` (plugin-dashboard), `DatasetReportRenderer` / `LegacyReportRenderer` (plugin-report), `DatasetPreview` / `CreateViewDialog` / `ObjectView` (app-shell), `ObjectChart`, `ObjectView` (plugin-view). Their rows are aggregate outputs (numbers) so no composed path regresses. Spot-check of the dev's consumer claim: `plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/`, app-shell `previews/`, `plugin-report/src` at head: 199 files / 2063 tests green. The 110-tile probe's claim "every tile that drew marks is unchanged" holds for every scalar shape I re-measured (46 probe cases) and fails only for the array and dotted-key shapes above, which its population did not contain.
- (f) Changeset `.changeset/7195-no-numeric-value-refusal.md` is `@object-ui/plugin-charts: patch`, the same level as the objectui#4695 precedent (`4695-no-series-binding-refusal.md`, patch) and objectui#4683 (published under 17.6.0 Patch Changes). - Dotted `dataKey`: `axisHasScale` and the `carried` gate read `row[key]` while Recharts reads `get(row, key)`; a nested key never anchors, so any carried non-numeric sibling turns a drawing tile into a refusal (bar 3 marks / line 2 marks on base, refusal on head).
- The source comment "Mirrors the reader Recharts builds the domain with" and the changeset's "What keeps drawing, unchanged" are true only for scalar values; both should say so once the array clause is added.
- Changeset sentence "`''` (placed at zero)" under "What keeps drawing": on bar / horizontal-bar / combo, `''` draws 0 rectangles on both trees (silent, unchanged), so "unchanged" is exact and "keeps drawing" is loose; the PR body states the bar case correctly.
- A stacked `line` with all-boolean values draws 0 marks and stays silent (measured, both trees); consistent with the dev's own note and with erring toward silence. Observation only.
- Absent series key (objectui#8266 shape) is intentionally silent; recommend the seat cut it as its own card (the dev's option B is well argued) rather than widen this PR.

Same file, `axisHasScale` and the `carried` gate in `hasNoNumericSeriesValue`: resolve a bound key the way Recharts does (a dotted path through the row), or treat a bound key that is not a plain own property of any row as unresolved and stay silent. Evidence: bar `series [{dataKey:'a.b'},{dataKey:'w'}]` over `{k:'a', a:{b:3}, w:true}, {k:'b', a:{b:5}, w:false}` draws 3 rectangles on base and refuses at head naming `a.b` and `w`; line with the same rows draws 2 paths on base and refuses at head. Add the reverse-control pin.
3. Correct the source comment sentence "Mirrors the reader Recharts builds the domain with, not `Number.isFinite`" and the changeset sentence "What keeps drawing, unchanged: numeric strings, `''` (placed at zero), `Date` values, ..." to cover the array clause once added (prose only; frontmatter and `patch` level stay).
